title: Rav Shmuel bar Nadav
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Arakhin 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.16b.2), asking R' Chanina. Some say he was R' Chanina's son-in-law; others say he asked R' Yehoshua ben Levi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Rabbi Shmuel bar Nadav, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3344&lang=en), while Hyman’s heading has Rav. Shmuel is the one who asks in each version. The son-in-law clause belongs to the second version, and Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi is the alternative person asked.
